assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are provisional rough geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: Recalculate every area, ratio, land-use partition, node and drawing after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, heritage controls, utilities, fire access, flood and engineering constraints are absent.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, demolition, road engineering, investment and permission decisions remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: Three building footprints are adaptive-reuse concept envelopes, not surveyed buildings or approved construction footprints.
The human scenario committee, operators and service desks are proposed governance roles without confirmed institutional commitments.
assumptions.impact: Phase 0 must name accountable operators, resources, permissions and stop authority.

assumptions.statement: Service quality, accessibility, energy, cost, satisfaction and incident metrics have no observed field baseline.
assumptions.impact: They remain unknown until audited pilots establish definitions and samples.

assumptions.statement: This revision uses public desk research and has not completed site survey or stakeholder interviews.
assumptions.impact: Observational and community claims are excluded; field work remains a prerequisite.

assumptions.statement: The six stitches, nine component types and three station plans are agent-generated spatial design objects under provisional boundaries, not surveyed or approved engineering geometry.
assumptions.impact: Their counts and internal references are reproducible, but their position, dimensions and delivery feasibility must be recalculated after official base maps, utilities, ownership and field audits are available.
